role: Inbound Sales Development Representative - Entry Level

hero.label: Made for Instrumentl
hero.headline: I want to bring nonprofits to Instrumentl's grant platform.
hero.subheadline: Instrumentl sits at a rare intersection: a YC-backed SaaS product solving a real, underfunded problem for nonprofits who desperately need better grant infrastructure. After spending this past summer at NextAfter working inside the B2B nonprofit fundraising world, I saw firsthand how much operational pain exists in this space. Instrumentl is building the solution, and I want to be part of the team bringing it to more organizations.

whyCompany.title: Nonprofits are underserved by modern SaaS, and Instrumentl knows it
whyCompany.body: Most grant management still happens in spreadsheets and sticky notes. Instrumentl is one of the few venture-backed teams actually building purpose-fit software for this workflow. That specificity is rare and it means the product sells itself to anyone who has lived the problem.

whyCompany.title: An entry-level inbound SDR role at a scaling YC company is the right bet
whyCompany.body: YC backing signals both product validation and a growth trajectory that makes early hires matter. An inbound SDR seat at this stage means real pipeline ownership, not just busy work. The timing feels like the kind of opportunity that looks obvious in hindsight.

whyCompany.title: My BDR and NextAfter experience map directly onto this motion
whyCompany.body: At Copygen.ai I ran cold outreach sequences in HubSpot and LinkedIn that helped close 15 to 20 paying clients, so I understand the mechanics of moving a prospect from first touch to conversation. At NextAfter, a B2B fundraising consultancy, I was embedded in the nonprofit sector and learned how these organizations think about tools and budget. That combination is exactly what an inbound SDR role at Instrumentl needs.

quote: I spent my summer inside the nonprofit fundraising world at NextAfter and kept seeing the same gap: organizations with real missions drowning in grant admin work. Instrumentl is the product I kept wishing my clients already had, and I want to be the person introducing it to them.
